descriptions.value: Integer overflow in Editing in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.79 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)
Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dataverse allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
